It takes advantage of the data value reference (dvr) structure together with the native classes and will add a full object-oriented support with excellent performance. This is the new generation of object-oriented support that makes LabVIEW as powerful as any object-oriented language. The G# Framework is a National Instrument Compatible with LabVIEW Gold product and was awarded "Add-On of the Year for Community" at NI Week 2011.\0A\0ANB! LabVIEW must be restarted to load the features that are integrated into the LabVIEW development environment, such as the right-click menu in the project explorer." The G# Framework is a National Instrument Compatible with LabVIEW Gold product and was awarded "Add-On of the Year for Community" at NI Week 2011.\0A\0ANB! It takes advantage of the data value reference structure (dvr) together with the native classes and will add a full object-oriented support with excellent performance. This is the new generation of object-oriented support that makes LabVIEW as powerful as any object-oriented language. The G# Framework is a National Instrument Compatible with LabVIEW Gold product and was awarded "Add-On of the Year for Community" at NI Week 2011.\0A\0ANB! LabVIEW must be restarted to load the features that are integrated into the LabVIEW development environment, such as the right-click menu in the project explorer." spec.spec: [Package] Name="qestit_lib_gsharp" Version="3.0.6.1" Release="" ID=1741345f7a7cb709e73dc53d56363578 File Format="vip" Format Version="2017" Display Name="G# Framework" [Description] Description="The G# Framework is a free, award winning add-on toolkit for LabVIEW that adds reference based object-oriented support. It takes advantage of the data value reference structure (dvr) together with the native classes and will add a full object-oriented support with excellent performance. This is the new generation of object-oriented support that makes LabVIEW as powerful as any object-oriented language. The G# Framework is a National Instrument Compatible with LabVIEW Gold product and was awarded "Add-On of the Year for Community" at NI Week 2011.\0A\0ANB! LabVIEW must be restarted to load the features that are integrated into the LabVIEW development environment, such as the right-click menu in the project explorer." Change class versions\0A\0AG# Framework 3.0.5\0A* Bugfix: Dependency Viewer\0A* Move examples, rename folder\0A* Help information updated\0A* Palette updated\0A\0AG# Framework 3.0.2\0A* Bugfix: Fix terminals #8.\0A* Bugfix: Error when creating a class in an unsaved lvlib #2.\0A* Bugfix: Error 1051 when creating a class with a name that already exists in memory #3.\0A* Bugfix: Error 1055 when
